message:
We were having one of those perfectly ordinary weekends when I decided it was time to finally organize our go-bags. As I emptied out old granola bars and mismatched socks, I found myself chuckling at the absurdity of it all. 

Who knew a family of four could accumulate so many expired snacks and random trinkets? It was like a mini museum of our past. 

After a good laugh, I realized that preparedness isn't just about the stuff we pack; it's about the laughter and moments we share while doing it together. 

So, whether it’s a go-bag or just sorting through the chaos, let’s keep a sense of humor as we get ready for whatever life brings. What’s the funniest thing you’ve found while prepping?
